name: Pork Steaks, Roast Potatoes and Veg
method: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Toss the chopped potatoes in half the oil with salt and pepper and roast for 35 to 40 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden.
Rub the pork steaks with the herbs and the remaining oil.
Fry the pork in a hot pan for 5 to 6 minutes each side until golden and cooked through with no pink inside, then rest for 3 minutes.
Boil the mixed veg for 4 minutes and drain. Serve the pork with the roast potatoes and veg.
